Model: 3410 Horizontal 
 Centrifugal with Horizontally Split Casing

This Document outlines the 
major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed 
every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title 
block

This pump used to supply cooling water for all 
plant auxiliaries.

The first draft initiated by eng. Mamdoh Anber 
tested by eng. Ali Abd Elsalam , and revised by EDEPC quality control engineer 
Abouda Elbana, accepted by general director eng. Yosry Abd Elmaqsood, and 
approved by eng. Awad Fathay head sector of Talkha Power Station.

Horizontal centrifugal with horizontally split 
casing

A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,

Safety fence
with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate the circuit breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric terminal of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated mechanically by 
 closing delivery and suction valves.
